The Promised Trillion Dollar AI-Coding Market

Trillion-dollar AI coding forecasts quietly assume nobody ever saves and reuses a verified solution.

[$1T Forecasts Assume Zero Verified Code Reuse]

1/3 Headline trillion-dollar figures for AI coding are mostly future projections and value guesses, not counts of money actually earned.

2/3 Almost every forecast quietly assumes programmers will pay a giant AI model by the word for every task forever.

3/3 When verified working code is saved and reused, repeated jobs drop toward the cost of electricity, shrinking vendor rent.

Energy class: unmetered (Market Forecast Audit; joules=null, never faked as zero).
